name: 28753 · Marshall, NC
findings: ZIP 28753 (Marshall) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28753 (Marshall) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28753 (Marshall) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
